title: Majhul nisbat va rasmiy uslub
goal_uz: Dars oxirida murakkab majhul shakllarni ishlatasiz, “it is said that” kabi shaxssiz tuzilmalarni tushunasiz va norasmiy matnni rasmiy uslubga qayta yoza olasiz.

scenes.title: Majhul nisbat va rasmiy uslub
board: Lesson: Passive and Formal Style
(Majhul nisbat va rasmiy uslub)
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time you learned to defend an opinion with evidence. Today we study the passive and formal style.
scenes.say_native: Xush kelibsiz! Oldingi darsda fikrni dalil bilan himoya qilishni o‘rgandik. Dars oxirida siz murakkab majhul shakllarni ishlatasiz, “it is said that” kabi tuzilmalarni tushunasiz va norasmiy matnni rasmiy uslubga qayta yoza olasiz. Bu ish xatlari, hisobotlar va IELTS yozma ishi uchun juda kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda fikrni dalil bilan himoya qilishni o‘rgandingiz. Bugun majhul nisbat va rasmiy uslubni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Majhul nisbat: eslatma
board: Passive = be + past participle
The report was written. (Hisobot yozildi.)
Object → Subject

examples.t: The company built the bridge.
The bridge was built by the company.

scenes.say: In an active sentence, the subject does the action. In a passive sentence, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject, and we use the verb be plus the past participle.
scenes.say_native: Avval asosni eslaymiz. Aktiv gapda ega ishni bajaradi, majhul gapda esa to‘ldiruvchi ega o‘rniga chiqadi. Zamon faqat “be” fe’lida o‘zgaradi: is built, was built, will be built. O‘zbek tilida ham “qurildi”, “yozildi” kabi -il, -in qo‘shimchasi bor, shuning uchun g‘oya tanish. Farqi shundaki, inglizchada har doim “be” kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Aktiv gapda ega ishni bajaradi. Majhul gapda esa to‘ldiruvchi ega bo‘ladi va biz be fe’li bilan past participle ishlatamiz.

scenes.title: Murakkab zamonlar majhul nisbatda
board: Present perfect: has been done
Present continuous: is being done
Past continuous: was being done
Past perfect: had been done

examples.t: The results have been published.
The road is being repaired.
The room was being cleaned when we arrived.

scenes.say: Perfect and continuous tenses also have passive forms. The results have been published. The road is being repaired.
scenes.say_native: Endi B2 uchun muhim qism: perfect va continuous zamonlarning majhul shakli. Formula oddiy: birinchi yordamchi fe’l zamonni beradi, keyin “been” yoki “being”, oxirida uchinchi shakl. Past perfect: had been deleted. “Being” faqat davom etayotgan jarayonda keladi, “been” esa tugallangan ishda. Shu ikki so‘zni aralashtirmang.
scenes.say_uz: Perfect va continuous zamonlarning ham majhul shakli bor. Natijalar e’lon qilingan. Yo‘l ta’mirlanmoqda.

scenes.title: Modal fe’llar bilan majhul nisbat
board: modal + be + V3: must be done
modal + have been + V3: should have been told
will have been + V3

examples.t: The form must be signed.
You should have been told earlier.
The work will have been completed by Friday.

scenes.say: With modal verbs, the passive is modal plus be plus participle. The form must be signed. For the past, use modal plus have been plus participle.
scenes.say_native: Modal fe’llar bilan majhul nisbat ikki shaklda keladi. Hozirgi yoki kelasi zamon uchun: modal, keyin “be”, keyin uchinchi shakl. The form must be signed. O‘tmish uchun: modal, “have been”, uchinchi shakl. Kelasi tugallangan zamon ham shunday: will have been completed. Modalning o‘zi hech qachon o‘zgarmaydi, uchinchi shaxsga “s” qo‘shilmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Modal fe’llar bilan majhul nisbat: modal, be, participle. Blank imzolanishi kerak. O‘tmish uchun: modal, have been, participle.

scenes.title: Majhul nisbat qachon kerak?
board: 1) Agent unknown: My bike was stolen.
2) Agent unimportant: The road was closed.
3) Focus on result / process
4) Formal, impersonal tone

examples.t: My bike was stolen last night.
Applications must be submitted by May.

scenes.say: We use the passive when the doer is unknown, obvious or unimportant, when we want to focus on the result, and when we want a formal, impersonal tone. My bike was stolen last night.
scenes.say_native: Majhul nisbatni tasodifiy ishlatmaymiz, uning to‘rt sababi bor. Birinchi: ishni kim qilgani noma’lum, masalan velosiped o‘g‘irlandi. Ikkinchi: bu muhim emas yoki o‘zi ma’lum. Uchinchi: natija yoki jarayon muhimroq. To‘rtinchi: rasmiy, shaxssiz ohang kerak. “By” bilan ish bajaruvchini faqat u yangi va muhim bo‘lsagina qo‘shing.
scenes.say_uz: Majhul nisbat ish bajaruvchi noma’lum, ahamiyatsiz bo‘lsa, natija muhim bo‘lsa va rasmiy ohang kerak bo‘lsa ishlatiladi. Velosipedim kecha o‘g‘irlandi.

scenes.title: O‘timsiz fe’l majhul bo‘lmaydi
board: ✗ The accident was happened.
✓ The accident happened.
✗ I was agreed with him.
✓ I agreed with him.

examples.t: The meeting took place on Monday.

scenes.say: Intransitive verbs have no object, so they cannot be passive. Do not say the accident was happened. Say the accident happened.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato. O‘zbek tilida “sodir bo‘ldi”, “yuz berdi” deymiz, shuning uchun ba’zilar “was happened” deb yuboradi. Lekin “happen” o‘timsiz fe’l, ya’ni to‘ldiruvchisi yo‘q, demak majhul nisbat ham yo‘q. Sinov: aktiv gapda “nimani?” savoliga javob bor-yo‘qligini tekshiring.
scenes.say_uz: O‘timsiz fe’llarning to‘ldiruvchisi yo‘q, shuning uchun ular majhul bo‘lmaydi. Accident was happened demang. The accident happened deng.

scenes.title: Majhul nisbatga aylantiring
board: 1) They are repairing the bridge. (hozir)
2) Someone has stolen my phone.
3) You must send the form.
4) They had cleaned the room before we came.
scenes.say: Change to the passive. One: They are repairing the bridge. Two: Someone has stolen my phone. Three: You must send the form. Four: They had cleaned the room before we came.
scenes.say_native: Mashq vaqti. To‘rtta gapni majhul nisbatga aylantiring va baland ovozda ayting. Birinchi gapda hozir davom etayotgan jarayon bor, ikkinchisida present perfect, uchinchisida modal fe’l, to‘rtinchisida past perfect. Avval zamonni aniqlang, keyin “be” ni shu zamonga qo‘ying, so‘ng uchinchi shaklni yozing.
scenes.say_uz: Majhul nisbatga aylantiring. Bir: ular ko‘prikni ta’mirlamoqda. Ikki: kimdir telefonimni o‘g‘irlagan. Uch: blankni yuborishingiz kerak. To‘rt: ular biz kelmasdan oldin xonani tozalagan edilar.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The bridge is being repaired.
2) My phone has been stolen.
3) The form must be sent.
4) The room had been cleaned before we came.
scenes.say: One: the bridge is being repaired. Two: my phone has been stolen. Three: the form must be sent. Four: the room had been cleaned before we came.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: The bridge is being repaired, chunki “being” davomiylikni ko‘rsatadi. Ikki: My phone has been stolen, “someone” tushib qoladi, chunki ish bajaruvchi noma’lum. Uch: The form must be sent. To‘rt: The room had been cleaned before we came. Qoida oddiy: jarayon bo‘lsa being, tugagan ish bo‘lsa been.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ko‘prik ta’mirlanmoqda. Ikki: telefonim o‘g‘irlangan. Uch: blank yuborilishi kerak. To‘rt: xona biz kelmasdan oldin tozalangan edi.

scenes.title: Ikki to‘ldiruvchili fe’llar va get-majhul
board: I was given a book. / A book was given to me.
give, send, offer, tell, show, pay
get + V3 = informal passive

examples.t: She was offered a new job.
I got fired last week.

scenes.say: Verbs like give, send, offer and show have two objects, so two passives are possible. I was given a book, or a book was given to me.
scenes.say_native: Give, send, offer, show, tell, pay kabi fe’llarda ikkita to‘ldiruvchi bor: kimga va nimani. “I was given a book” va “A book was given to me”. Yana bir narsa: so‘zlashuvda “be” o‘rniga “get” ishlatiladi: I got fired, he got promoted. Bu norasmiy, kutilmagan voqea haqida. Rasmiy matnda “was dismissed”, “was promoted” yozing.
scenes.say_uz: Give, send, offer, show kabi fe’llarning ikkita to‘ldiruvchisi bor, shuning uchun ikki xil majhul gap mumkin. Menga kitob berildi, yoki kitob menga berildi.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 1) The house was been sold last year.
2) The letter was wrote by my boss.
3) The festival was taken place in May.
4) The documents signed already.
scenes.say: Find and correct the mistake in each sentence. One: the house was been sold last year. Two: the letter was wrote by my boss. Three: the festival was taken place in May. Four: the documents signed already.
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapda bitta xato bor. Uni toping va to‘g‘ri variantni ayting. Maslahat: birinchi gapda ikkita yordamchi fe’l bor, ikkinchisida uchinchi shakl noto‘g‘ri, uchinchisida fe’l umuman majhul bo‘lishi mumkin emas, to‘rtinchisida esa yordamchi fe’l yetishmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapdagi xatoni toping va to‘g‘rilang. Uy o‘tgan yili sotilgan. Xatni boshlig‘im yozgan. Festival may oyida bo‘lib o‘tdi. Hujjatlar allaqachon imzolangan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The house was sold last year.
2) The letter was written by my boss.
3) The festival took place in May.
4) The documents have already been signed.
scenes.say: One: the house was sold last year. Two: the letter was written by my boss. Three: the festival took place in May. Four: the documents have already been signed.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: was sold, “been” ortiqcha. Ikki: was written, chunki “write” tartibsiz fe’l, uchinchi shakli “written”. Uch: took place, bu o‘timsiz ibora, majhul bo‘lmaydi. To‘rt: have already been signed, “already” yordamchi fe’ldan keyin turadi. Hammasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, majhul nisbatni yaxshi o‘zlashtirgansiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: uy o‘tgan yili sotilgan. Ikki: xatni boshlig‘im yozgan. Uch: festival may oyida bo‘lib o‘tdi. To‘rt: hujjatlar allaqachon imzolangan.

scenes.title: Shaxssiz tuzilma: It is said that
board: It + passive + that-clause
It is said that he is a genius.
It is believed / reported / thought / known / expected that ...

examples.t: It is said that the castle is haunted.
It is reported that prices will rise.

scenes.say: The first impersonal pattern is it plus passive verb plus that-clause. It is said that the castle is haunted. It is reported that prices will rise.
scenes.say_native: Endi ikkinchi mavzu: shaxssiz tuzilmalar. Birinchi qolip: “It” bilan boshlanadi, keyin majhul fe’l, keyin “that” bilan to‘liq gap. O‘zbekchada bu “aytishlaricha”, “ishoniladiki”, “xabar qilinishicha”. Manbani nomlamasdan, umumiy fikr yoki yangilikni berish uchun ishlatamiz. Gazeta va hisobotlarda juda ko‘p uchraydi.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi shaxssiz qolip: it, majhul fe’l va that bilan gap. Aytishlaricha, qal’a arvohlar makoni. Xabar qilinishicha, narxlar ko‘tariladi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi qolip: ega + majhul + infinitive
board: He is said to be rich. (hozir)
He is said to have left. (o‘tmish)
He is said to be working. (davom)
There is thought to be a problem.

examples.t: The minister is believed to be in Paris.
The thieves are thought to have escaped by car.

scenes.say: The second pattern puts the person or thing as the subject, followed by a passive verb and an infinitive. He is said to be rich. He is said to have left. He is said to be working.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi qolip ixchamroq: gapning egasi o‘zi bo‘ladi, keyin majhul fe’l va “to” bilan infinitiv. Infinitivning shakli vaqtni bildiradi: “to be” hozirgi holat, “to have left” undan oldingi voqea, “to be working” hozir davom etayotgan ish. Mavjudlik haqida “there” bilan ham ishlatiladi: there is thought to be a problem.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi qolip: ega, majhul fe’l va infinitiv. U boy ekani aytiladi. U ketgan ekani aytiladi. U ishlayotgani aytiladi.

scenes.title: Yangiliklar xabari
board: The mayor is said to be planning to resign.
He is believed to have lost support.
It is expected that a decision will be made soon.

examples.t: The mayor is said to be planning to resign.

scenes.say: The mayor is said to be planning to resign. He is believed to have lost the support of his party. It is expected that a decision will be made by the end of the week. The mayor himself has not commented.
scenes.say_native: Haqiqiy yangilik uslubidagi matnni tinglang. Bu yerda uchala tuzilma bir joyda: “is said to be planning” hozirgi reja, “is believed to have lost” o‘tgan voqea, “it is expected that” esa kelajak haqida taxmin. Jurnalistlar shu tarzda tasdiqlanmagan ma’lumotni mas’uliyatsiz ayta olmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Mer iste’foga chiqishni rejalashtirayotgani aytiladi. U o‘z partiyasining qo‘llab-quvvatlashini yo‘qotgan deb hisoblanadi. Qaror hafta oxirigacha qabul qilinishi kutilmoqda. Merning o‘zi izoh bermagan.

scenes.title: Shaxssiz qolipdagi xatolar
board: ✗ It is said him to be rich.
✓ He is said to be rich. / It is said that he is rich.
✗ He is said that he is rich.
✗ It is said to be he rich.
scenes.say: Do not mix the two patterns. It is said that he is rich. Or: he is said to be rich.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita qolipni aralashtirib yubormang. Birinchisi: “It is said that he is rich”, ya’ni it, that va to‘liq gap. Ikkinchisi: “He is said to be rich”, ya’ni ega va infinitiv. Xatolar: “It is said him to be rich” va “He is said that he is rich”. Eslab qoling: “it” bilan faqat “that”, ega bilan faqat “to”.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki qolipni aralashtirmang. It bilan that-gap, ega bilan infinitiv ishlating.

scenes.title: Gapni qayta yozing
board: 1) People say that she is very talented.
2) They believe that he stole the money.
3) Experts think the economy is growing. (to be)
4) People report that the roads are blocked.
scenes.say: Rewrite using the passive. One: People say that she is very talented. Two: They believe that he stole the money, with an infinitive. Three: Experts think the economy is growing, with an infinitive. Four: People report that the roads are blocked, with it.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni qayta yozing. Birinchi gapni ikkala usulda ayting. Ikkinchi gapda “he” ni ega qilib, infinitiv ishlating va o‘tgan voqeani unutmang, ya’ni “to have”. Uchinchi gapda davom etayotgan jarayon uchun “to be growing”. To‘rtinchisini “it” bilan boshlang.
scenes.say_uz: Majhul tuzilma bilan qayta yozing. Odamlar uning juda iqtidorli ekanini aytadi. Ular uni pulni o‘g‘irlagan deb hisoblaydi. Mutaxassislar iqtisodiyot o‘syapti deb o‘ylaydi. Odamlar yo‘llar to‘silgani haqida xabar beradi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) It is said that she is very talented. / She is said to be very talented.
2) He is believed to have stolen the money.
3) The economy is thought to be growing.
4) It is reported that the roads are blocked.
scenes.say: One: she is said to be very talented. Two: he is believed to have stolen the money. Three: the economy is thought to be growing. Four: it is reported that the roads are blocked.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: She is said to be very talented yoki It is said that she is very talented. Ikki: He is believed to have stolen the money, pul o‘g‘irlanishi oldin bo‘lgani uchun “to have stolen”. Uch: The economy is thought to be growing. To‘rt: It is reported that the roads are blocked, “reported” bilan “it” varianti tabiiyroq.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: u juda iqtidorli ekani aytiladi. Ikki: u pulni o‘g‘irlagan deb hisoblanadi. Uch: iqtisodiyot o‘syapti deb hisoblanadi. To‘rt: yo‘llar to‘silgani xabar qilinmoqda.

scenes.title: Boshqa shaxssiz iboralar
board: It has been decided that ...
It is hoped / feared / recommended that ...
It should be noted that ...
It is widely accepted that ...

examples.t: It should be noted that the figures are approximate.
It is widely accepted that exercise improves health.
examples.uz: Mashq salomatlikni yaxshilashi keng e’tirof etilgan.

scenes.say: There are many useful impersonal phrases for formal writing. It has been decided that, it is hoped that, it is recommended that, it should be noted that, and it is widely accepted that.
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy yozuvda ishlatiladigan tayyor iboralarni yodlab oling. It has been decided that, ya’ni qaror qilindi. It is hoped that, umid qilinadi. It is recommended that, tavsiya etiladi. It is widely accepted that, keng e’tirof etilgan. Esse yoki hisobotda “I think” o‘rniga ularni ishlatsangiz, uslub darrov balandroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy yozuv uchun foydali iboralar: qaror qilindi, umid qilinadi, tavsiya etiladi, shuni ta’kidlash kerak, keng e’tirof etilgan. Ular matnni ob’ektiv qiladi.

scenes.title: Uch daraja: norasmiy, neytral, rasmiy
board: Informal: Can you tell me how much it is?
Neutral: Could you tell me the price?
Formal: I would be grateful if you could inform me of the price.

examples.t: Could you tell me the price?

scenes.say: English has three main levels of register. Informal: Can you tell me how much it is? Neutral: Could you tell me the price?
scenes.say_native: Endi uslub, ya’ni register haqida. Inglizchada uch daraja bor. Norasmiy: do‘st bilan, “Can you tell me how much it is?”. Neytral: begona bilan odatiy muomalada, “Could you tell me the price?”. Rasmiy: “I would be grateful if you could inform me of the price”. Mazmun bir xil, masofa boshqa. O‘zbekchada ham “sen” va “siz” darajalari bor.
scenes.say_uz: Inglizchada uslubning uch darajasi bor. Norasmiy: narxi qancha ekanini ayta olasanmi? Neytral: narxni ayta olasizmi?

scenes.title: Lug‘at: oddiy so‘zdan rasmiy so‘zga
board: ask for → request
get → obtain / receive
need → require
buy → purchase
start → commence
but → however
so → therefore
help → assist

examples.t: We require your signature.
Please find the document attached.

scenes.say: Formal writing prefers different words. Ask for becomes request. Get becomes obtain or receive. Need becomes require. Buy becomes purchase.
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy matnda oddiy so‘zlar boshqasiga almashadi. Ask for o‘rniga request, get o‘rniga obtain yoki receive, need o‘rniga require, buy o‘rniga purchase, start o‘rniga commence, help o‘rniga assist. Bog‘lovchilar ham: but o‘rniga however, so o‘rniga therefore. Bu so‘zlarni o‘rinli ishlating, hamma joyda emas.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy yozuv boshqa so‘zlarni afzal ko‘radi. Ask for o‘rniga request, get o‘rniga obtain, need o‘rniga require, buy o‘rniga purchase.

scenes.title: Rasmiy grammatika belgilari
board: No contractions: do not, cannot
Passive and nominalisation
Fewer phrasal verbs: investigate, not look into
Longer, complete sentences

examples.t: The matter will be investigated.
We were unable to attend.

scenes.say: Besides vocabulary, formal grammar has clear signs. Avoid contractions: write do not and cannot. Use the passive.
scenes.say_native: Rasmiylikni so‘z bilan birga grammatika ham belgilaydi. Birinchi: qisqartmalar yo‘q, “don’t” o‘rniga “do not”, “can’t” o‘rniga “cannot”. Ikkinchi: majhul nisbat ko‘p. Uchinchi: iboraviy fe’llar kam, “look into” o‘rniga “investigate”, “put off” o‘rniga “postpone”, “carry out” o‘rniga “conduct”. Bularni birgalikda qo‘llang.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy grammatikaning aniq belgilari bor. Qisqartmalardan qoching: do not va cannot yozing. Majhul nisbatni ishlating.

scenes.title: Uslubni aralashtirib yuborish
board: ✗ Dear Sir, I wanna ask about the job.
✓ Dear Sir, I would like to enquire about the position.
✗ Hello Mr Brown, long time no see, buddy!
✓ Good morning, Mr Brown. It is a pleasure to see you.
scenes.say: Do not mix registers. Dear Sir, I wanna ask about the job sounds strange. Write: Dear Sir, I would like to enquire about the position.
scenes.say_native: Uslubni aralashtirish xatosi ikki tomonlama. “I would be grateful if you could assist me” deb do‘stingizga aytsangiz, kulgili tuyuladi. Qoida: kimga, nima uchun va qaysi kanalda yozayotganingizni o‘ylang, keyin uslubni tanlang va butun matn bo‘ylab saqlang.
scenes.say_uz: Uslubni aralashtirmang. Rasmiy xatda wanna emas, I would like to enquire deng. Do‘stlar bilan esa haddan tashqari rasmiy bo‘lmang.

scenes.title: Uslubni aniqlang
board: 1) Thanks a lot for your help!
2) We regret to inform you that your application has been unsuccessful.
3) Could you send me the file, please?
4) Sorry mate, can’t make it tonight.
scenes.say: Decide: informal, neutral or formal? One: Thanks a lot for your help. Two: We regret to inform you that your application has been unsuccessful. Three: Could you send me the file, please? Four: Sorry mate, can't make it tonight.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapning uslubini aniqlang: norasmiy, neytral yoki rasmiy. Belgilarga qarang: qisqartmalar, “mate” kabi so‘zlar, majhul nisbat, “regret to inform” kabi qotib qolgan iboralar, “could you” kabi muloyim so‘rov. Har bir gap uchun javobingizni baland ovozda ayting va sababini qisqa izohlang.
scenes.say_uz: Uslubni aniqlang. Yordamingiz uchun katta rahmat. Afsuski, arizangiz qabul qilinmadi. Faylni yuborasizmi, iltimos? Kechirasan do‘stim, bugun kechqurun kela olmayman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Informal
2) Formal
3) Neutral
4) Informal
scenes.say: One: informal. Two: formal. Three: neutral. Four: informal.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: norasmiy, chunki “thanks a lot” so‘zlashuv iborasi. Ikki: rasmiy, chunki “we regret to inform you” qotib qolgan rasmiy ibora va majhul nisbat bor. Uch: neytral, “could you” va “please” odatiy muloyim so‘rov. To‘rt: norasmiy, chunki “mate” va qisqartma bor. Uslubni bir necha belgi birga ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: norasmiy. Ikki: rasmiy. Uch: neytral. To‘rt: norasmiy.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ofisdagi e’lon
board: A: Have you seen the notice?
B: Yes. The office will be closed for repairs.
A: It is expected to reopen next month.
scenes.say: Anna: Have you seen the notice? The office is being renovated. Ben: Yes. It says that all staff will be relocated to the second floor. Anna: It is expected to take three weeks, and parking will not be available during that time. Ben: So employees are advised to use public transport. I'll get a bus pass.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki hamkasb ofisdagi e’lon haqida gaplashmoqda. Ko‘ring, e’londa majhul nisbat ko‘p, ular og‘zaki gapirishda esa norasmiyroq javob beradi. Diqqat bilan eshiting: ofis nima uchun yopiladi, xodimlar qayerga ko‘chiriladi, nima mavjud bo‘lmaydi va Ben nima qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: E’lonni ko‘rdingizmi? Ofis ta’mirlanmoqda. Ben: Ha. Unda barcha xodimlar ikkinchi qavatga ko‘chirilishi yozilgan. Anna: Uch hafta davom etishi kutilmoqda, bu vaqtda to‘xtash joyi bo‘lmaydi. Ben: Demak, xodimlarga jamoat transportidan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi. Men avtobus kartasini olaman.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What is happening to the office?
2) Where will staff be moved?
3) How long will it take?
4) What will Ben do?
scenes.say: Answer the questions. One: what is happening to the office? Two: where will staff be moved? Three: how long is it expected to take? Four: what will Ben do?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Bir: ofisga nima bo‘lyapti? Ikki: xodimlar qayerga ko‘chiriladi? Uch: bu qancha vaqt davom etadi? To‘rt: Ben nima qiladi? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan, imkon bo‘lsa majhul nisbat bilan ayting. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni yana bir marta eslang.
scenes.say_uz: Savollarga javob bering. Ofisga nima bo‘lyapti? Xodimlar qayerga ko‘chiriladi? Bu qancha davom etishi kutilmoqda? Ben nima qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) It is being renovated.
2) To the second floor.
3) About three weeks.
4) He will get a bus pass.
scenes.say: One: the office is being renovated. Two: staff will be relocated to the second floor. Three: it is expected to take three weeks. Four: Ben will get a bus pass.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: The office is being renovated, ya’ni ta’mirlanmoqda. Ikki: Staff will be relocated to the second floor. Uch: It is expected to take three weeks, taxminan uch hafta. To‘rt: Ben avtobus kartasini oladi. E’tibor bering, Annaning gaplarida majhul nisbat e’lon uslubini beradi, Benning gapi esa shaxsiy: “I’ll get”.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ofis ta’mirlanmoqda. Ikki: xodimlar ikkinchi qavatga ko‘chiriladi. Uch: uch hafta davom etishi kutilmoqda. To‘rt: Ben avtobus kartasini oladi.

scenes.title: Aktivdan rasmiyga: besh qadam
board: 1) Who does it? Keep or remove the agent
2) Use passive / impersonal
3) Replace phrasal verbs and informal words
4) Nominalise: decide → decision
5) No contractions
scenes.say: Here is a five-step method for rewriting. First, decide whether the doer matters. Second, use the passive or an impersonal structure.
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy uslubga o‘tkazish uchun besh qadamli usul. Birinchi: ish bajaruvchi kerakmi yoki yo‘qmi, hal qiling. Ikkinchi: majhul nisbat yoki shaxssiz qolip ishlating. Uchinchi: iboraviy fe’l va norasmiy so‘zlarni almashtiring. Beshinchi: qisqartmalarni oching. Har qadamni tartib bilan bajarsangiz, har qanday gapni rasmiylashtira olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Qayta yozishning besh qadami bor. Birinchi, ish bajaruvchi muhimmi yoki yo‘qmi, hal qiling. Ikkinchi, majhul nisbat yoki shaxssiz tuzilma ishlating.

scenes.title: Oldin va keyin
board: Informal: We can’t give you your money back until we’ve looked into it.
Formal: A refund cannot be issued until the matter has been investigated.

examples.t: We’ve decided to put off the meeting.
It has been decided to postpone the meeting.

scenes.say: Informal: We can't give you your money back until we've looked into it. Formal: A refund cannot be issued until the matter has been investigated. We removed contractions, we used the passive, and we replaced look into with investigate.
scenes.say_native: Mana bir misol. Norasmiy: “We can’t give you your money back until we’ve looked into it.” Rasmiy: “A refund cannot be issued until the matter has been investigated.” Nima o‘zgardi? “We” yo‘qoldi, majhul nisbat paydo bo‘ldi, “look into” o‘rniga “investigate”, qisqartmalar ochildi. Gap uzunroq, lekin aniqroq va hurmatli eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Norasmiy gap rasmiy gapga aylandi: majhul nisbat, bitta fe’l va qisqartmasiz shakl. Yig‘ilishni qoldirish qarori qabul qilindi.

scenes.title: Nominalizatsiya: fe’ldan otga
board: decide → decision
improve → improvement
fail → failure
introduce → introduction
arrive → arrival

examples.t: The introduction of the new rules caused confusion.
examples.uz: Yangi qoidalarning joriy etilishi chalkashlik keltirib chiqardi.

examples.t: Failure to pay will result in a fine.

scenes.say: Nominalisation means using a noun instead of a verb. We introduced new rules, so people were confused becomes: The introduction of new rules caused confusion.
scenes.say_native: Nominalizatsiya, ya’ni fe’lni otga aylantirish, rasmiy uslubning kuchli vositasi. “We introduced new rules, so people were confused” o‘rniga “The introduction of new rules caused confusion”. Ot ega bo‘lib kelsa, gap mavhum va jiddiy eshitiladi. Ammo ortiqcha ishlatmang, matn og‘irlashib ketadi.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’lni otga aylantirsak, gap rasmiy bo‘ladi. Yangi qoidalarning joriy etilishi chalkashlik keltirib chiqardi.

scenes.title: Haddan tashqari majhul nisbat
board: ✗ A mistake was made. (kim?)
✓ I made a mistake. / We made an error.
✗ It is hoped that it is understood that ...
✓ Vague + too many passives = unclear
scenes.say: Do not overuse the passive. A mistake was made hides who is responsible. If clarity or honesty matters, use the active: I made a mistake.
scenes.say_native: Majhul nisbat har doim yaxshi emas. “A mistake was made” gapida kim xato qilgani yashiringan, bu ba’zan mas’uliyatdan qochish kabi eshitiladi. Shaxsiy xatda, ayniqsa uzr so‘raganda, aktiv ishlating: “I made a mistake” yoki “We apologise”. Qoida: aniqlik birinchi o‘rinda, uslub ikkinchi.
scenes.say_uz: Majhul nisbatni haddan ziyod ishlatmang. A mistake was made kim mas’ulligini yashiradi. Aniqlik muhim bo‘lsa, aktivdan foydalaning: I made a mistake.

scenes.title: Rasmiy uslubga o‘tkazing
board: 1) We can’t accept late applications.
2) People think the new law will help small firms.
3) They put off the match because of the rain.
4) We’ll tell you when we’ve made a decision.
scenes.say: Rewrite in formal style. One: We can't accept late applications. Two: People think the new law will help small firms. Three: They put off the match because of the rain. Four: We'll tell you when we've made a decision.
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘rtta gapni rasmiy uslubga o‘tkazing. Majhul nisbat, shaxssiz qolip, bitta fe’l va nominalizatsiya imkoniyatlaridan foydalaning. Masalan, uchinchi gapda “put off” ni “postpone” bilan, to‘rtinchida “decision” otini ishlatsangiz bo‘ladi. Har bir gapni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy uslubga o‘tkazing. Kechikkan arizalarni qabul qila olmaymiz. Odamlar yangi qonun kichik firmalarga yordam beradi deb o‘ylaydi. Ular yomg‘ir sababli o‘yinni qoldirdi. Qaror qabul qilinganda sizga xabar beramiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Late applications cannot be accepted.
2) The new law is expected to benefit small firms.
3) The match was postponed due to rain.
4) You will be informed once a decision has been made.
scenes.say: One: late applications cannot be accepted. Two: the new law is expected to benefit small firms. Three: the match was postponed due to rain. Four: you will be informed once a decision has been made.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: Late applications cannot be accepted. Ikki: The new law is expected to benefit small firms, bu yerda “help” o‘rniga “benefit”. Uch: The match was postponed due to rain, “put off” o‘rniga “postponed”, “because of” o‘rniga “due to”. Sizning variantingiz biroz farq qilishi mumkin, muhimi aniqlik va rasmiy ohang saqlanganligi.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: kechikkan arizalar qabul qilinmaydi. Ikki: yangi qonun kichik firmalarga foyda keltirishi kutilmoqda. Uch: o‘yin yomg‘ir sababli qoldirildi. To‘rt: qaror qabul qilingach, sizga xabar beriladi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: shikoyat telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘i
board: Customer: My order has not been delivered.
Agent: I apologise. It will be investigated.
Customer: When will I be contacted?
scenes.say: Customer: Good morning. My order was supposed to be delivered on Monday, but it has not been received. Agent: I do apologise. Your parcel appears to have been sent to the wrong address. The matter will be investigated, and you will be contacted within twenty-four hours. Customer: Will I be refunded? Agent: If it cannot be found, a full refund will be issued.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: mijoz va xizmat operatori. Operator rasmiy uslubda gapiradi, shuning uchun majhul nisbat ko‘p, mijoz esa erkinroq. Quyidagilarni eshitib oling: buyurtma qachon yetkazilishi kerak edi, bu nima uchun sodir bo‘ldi, operator nimani va'da qildi va pul qaytariladimi.
scenes.say_uz: Mijoz: Xayrli kun. Buyurtmam dushanba kuni yetkazilishi kerak edi, ammo olinmadi. Operator: Uzr so‘rayman. Posilkangiz noto‘g‘ri manzilga yuborilgan ko‘rinadi. Masala tekshiriladi va yigirma to‘rt soat ichida siz bilan bog‘lanishadi. Mijoz: Pulim qaytariladimi? Operator: Agar topilmasa, to‘liq pul qaytariladi.

scenes.title: Dialogni tushuning
board: 1) When was the order due?
2) Why did the problem happen?
3) When will the customer be contacted?
4) What happens if the parcel is not found?
scenes.say: Answer. One: when was the order due? Two: why did the problem happen? Three: when will the customer be contacted? Four: what happens if the parcel is not found?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Bir: buyurtma qachon kelishi kerak edi? Ikki: muammo nega yuz berdi? Uch: mijoz bilan qachon bog‘lanishadi? To‘rt: posilka topilmasa nima bo‘ladi? Operatorning majhul nisbatdagi gaplarini eslang va javobni ham shunday tuzishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Buyurtma qachon kelishi kerak edi? Muammo nega yuz berdi? Mijoz bilan qachon bog‘lanishadi? Posilka topilmasa nima bo‘ladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) On Monday.
2) It was sent to the wrong address.
3) Within twenty-four hours.
4) A full refund will be issued.
scenes.say: One: on Monday. Two: it appears to have been sent to the wrong address. Three: within twenty-four hours. Four: a full refund will be issued.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: dushanba kuni. Ikki: posilka noto‘g‘ri manzilga yuborilgan ko‘rinadi, “appears to have been sent” tuzilmasi. Uch: yigirma to‘rt soat ichida bog‘lanishadi. To‘rt: topilmasa, to‘liq pul qaytariladi. Operator “we” deb ayb olmaydi, majhul nisbat bilan professional masofani saqlaydi. Xizmat sohasida bu odatiy uslub.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: dushanba kuni. Ikki: noto‘g‘ri manzilga yuborilgan. Uch: yigirma to‘rt soat ichida. To‘rt: to‘liq pul qaytariladi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: majhul nisbatda kuchsiz shakllar
board: was /wəz/, been /bɪn/, been done /bɪn ˈdʌn/
has been /həz bɪn/
The room was cleaned. → /ðə ruːm wəz kliːnd/
Stress: content words
scenes.say: In natural speech, the auxiliary verbs are weak. Was sounds like wuz. Been is usually pronounced bin. Has been sounds like hazbin.
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda bir muhim nuqta. Majhul nisbatdagi yordamchi fe’llar urg‘usiz va kuchsiz aytiladi. “Was” taxminan “vəz”, “been” odatda qisqa “bin”, “has been” esa “həz bin”. Agar har bir so‘zni teng kuch bilan aytsangiz, nutqingiz robotga o‘xshaydi. Faqat “been” ni “bi:n” deb uzun aytish ham mumkin, lekin odatiy gapda qisqa bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy nutqda yordamchi fe’llar kuchsiz aytiladi. Was “vaz”ga o‘xshaydi. Been odatda “bin” deb aytiladi. Has been “hazbin”ga o‘xshaydi.

scenes.title: Ovoz chiqarib o‘qing
board: The report has been SIGNED.
The room was being CLEANED.
It is expected to be COMPLETED soon.
scenes.say: Repeat after me. The report has been signed. The room was being cleaned. It is expected to be completed soon.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Yordamchi fe’llarni tez va yengil, asosiy fe’lni esa aniq va balandroq ayting. Masalan, “has been” deyarli bitta so‘zdek, “signed” esa aniq. Har bir gapni ikki marta ayting va ritmga e’tibor bering. O‘zbekcha ritmdagi teng bo‘g‘inlarni inglizchada ataylab kuchsizlantiring.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang. Hisobot imzolangan. Xona tozalanayotgan edi. Uning tez orada tugallanishi kutilmoqda.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: e’lon yozing
board: Informal notice:
Hi all! We’re closing the gym next week because we’re fixing the floor. We’ll tell you when we’ve finished. Sorry!
scenes.say: Final task. Rewrite this informal notice in formal style, using at least two passive forms and one impersonal structure. Hi all, we are closing the gym next week because we are fixing the floor. We will tell you when we have finished. Sorry.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa. Doskada norasmiy e’lon bor. Uni rasmiy uslubda yozing yoki baland ovozda ayting. Kamida ikkita majhul shakl va bitta shaxssiz tuzilma ishlating. Masalan, “closing” ni “will be closed”, “fixing” ni “is being repaired” deb o‘zgartirishingiz mumkin. Avval beshta qadamni eslang, keyin yozing.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa. Norasmiy e’lonni rasmiy uslubda qayta yozing. Kamida ikkita majhul shakl va bitta shaxssiz tuzilma ishlating.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: The gymnasium will be closed next week. The floor is being repaired. Members will be informed when work has been completed. We apologise for any inconvenience.
scenes.say: Here is a model. The gymnasium will be closed next week while the floor is being repaired. Members will be informed when the work has been completed.
scenes.say_native: Mana namunaviy javob. “The gymnasium will be closed next week while the floor is being repaired. Members will be informed when the work has been completed.” Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, tekshirish mezoni oddiy: ohang rasmiy, mazmun to‘liq va xatosiz.
scenes.say_uz: Gimnaziya kelasi hafta yopiladi, pol ta’mirlanadi. Ish tugagach, a’zolarga xabar beriladi. Noqulaylik minimal bo‘lishi umid qilinadi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Passive: be + V3 in every tense, modal + be / have been + V3
It is said that / He is said to ...
Informal → neutral → formal
Rewrite: agent, passive, vocabulary, nouns, no contractions
scenes.say: Let's review. The passive is be plus a past participle in every tense, and modals use be or have been.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: majhul nisbat har bir zamonda “be” va uchinchi shakl bilan quriladi; modal fe’llardan keyin “be” yoki “have been” keladi. Ikkinchi: shaxssiz qoliplar: “it is said that” va “he is said to”. Uchinchi: uslub uch darajada: norasmiy, neytral, rasmiy. Endi uyga vazifa.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Majhul nisbat har bir zamonda be va uchinchi shakl bilan quriladi, modallar esa be yoki have been ishlatadi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: rewrite an informal text in formal style
Use 3+ passives and 1 impersonal structure
scenes.say: Your homework is to take a short informal message, about eight sentences, and rewrite it in formal style. Next time we will talk about education and technology.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: sakkiz-o‘nta gapdan iborat norasmiy xabarni, masalan do‘stingizga yozgan xatni, rasmiy uslubda qayta yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida uchta majhul shakl, bitta shaxssiz tuzilma, bitta nominalizatsiya, qisqartmalar yo‘q va ohang boshdan oxirigacha rasmiy. Keyingi darsda ta’lim va texnologiya mavzusini o‘rganamiz. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: norasmiy matnni rasmiy uslubda qayta yozish. Keyingi darsda ta’lim va texnologiya haqida gaplashamiz.

homework_uz: Sakkiz-o‘nta gapdan iborat norasmiy xabarni rasmiy uslubda qayta yozing: kamida uchta majhul shakl, bitta shaxssiz tuzilma, bitta nominalizatsiya ishlating, qisqartmalarsiz va boshdan oxirigacha rasmiy ohangda yozing.

quiz.q: Choose the correct passive: "They are repairing the road."
quiz.why_uz: Hozirgi davomiy zamon majhul shakli: is being + V3.

quiz.q: "You should have been told earlier." This is:
quiz.why_uz: Modal + have been + V3 o‘tmishdagi majhul modal shakl.

options: It is said him to be rich.
He is said that he is rich.
He is said to be rich.
quiz.why_uz: Ega + is said + to + infinitiv qolipi to‘g‘ri.

quiz.q: "He is believed to have left." The leaving happened:
quiz.why_uz: To have + V3 oldingi voqeani bildiradi.
"Required" va majhul nisbat eng rasmiy ohangni beradi.
Rasmiy matnda iboraviy fe’l o‘rniga postpone ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Which is NOT a feature of formal style?
quiz.why_uz: Jargon va slang rasmiy uslubga mos emas.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form: "The room ___ cleaned every day."
quiz.why_uz: Majhul nisbatda be fe’li kerak: is cleaned.

quiz.q: Nominalise: "They decided to close the school."
options: The decision to close the school
